identity.name: Commonwealth Indian
identity.location: 11610 Old Georgetown Road, North Bethesda (Rockville mailing address), MD 20852
identity.notes: The canonical compound label does not describe two restaurants. All live first-party surfaces bind one North Bethesda restaurant at 11610 Old Georgetown Road, shown with a Rockville mailing address; no Commonwealth Indian location in Silver Spring was found, so no Silver Spring menu was merged.

sources.excerpt: The official site identifies a single Commonwealth Indian restaurant at 11610 Old Georgetown Road, described as North Bethesda and displayed with a Rockville, MD 20852 mailing address and phone 240-833-3055.
The current Menu page is a link-only hub to the exact Toast store and contains no independent product list.
The current weekday lunch page lists four $16.99 combos, Monday through Friday from 11:30 AM to 3 PM, and asks guests to inform the server about food allergies.
The current happy-hour images list five food offerings Monday through Friday from 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM; the alcohol-only image was excluded.
The February 2026 prix-fixe image publishes $50, $45, and $40 family-style three-course packages for groups of at least ten.
The in-house vegetarian prix-fixe image publishes $35, $40, and $45 per-person packages with appetizer, entree, and dessert choices.

The official two-page catering tray menu lists current salads, sides, appetizers, tandoori items, entrees, biryanis, breads, desserts, tray sizes, and minimum quantities for the same 11610 Old Georgetown Road restaurant.

The restaurant-linked Toast store is bound to 11610 Old Georgetown Road, Rockville, MD and publishes Lunch, Food, N/A Beverage, and Catering menus. Non-food chafing equipment and a catering deposit were excluded.
A current item dialog gives the literal shrimp-and-yogurt description and a generic best-efforts special-request advisory, but no allergen matrix, absence guarantee, or cross-contact statement.

Targeted official-domain, PDF/document, exact Toast, allergen, nutrition, ingredient, and location searches found the current menus but no restaurant-issued allergen matrix or cross-contact document; results support only the North Bethesda/Rockville address.

findings.summary: The record represents one restaurant at 11610 Old Georgetown Road in North Bethesda, using a Rockville, MD 20852 mailing address; no separate Silver Spring Commonwealth Indian location is supported.
Current first-party and linked surfaces resolve to 181 food/nonalcoholic products across 22 complete current surfaces, including timed lunch/happy-hour, prix-fixe, beverage, and catering menus.
Disposable Chafing Dish is still sold through Toast but is catering equipment rather than food or a nonalcoholic beverage and must remain outside the POC product catalog.
The live catalog adds 58 products beyond the reconciled baseline set. Palak and Korma repeat under two Food Menu sections using the same Toast item links and are each represented once canonically.
All four required searches found no official product-by-allergen matrix or restaurant-level cross-contact statement; direct positives are limited to literal current ingredient evidence.

proposedChanges: Bind the compound canonical record to the single 11610 Old Georgetown Road North Bethesda restaurant with its Rockville mailing address; do not merge a Silver Spring location.
Replace the baseline projection with the complete 181-product current union and preserve the 22 positional surface memberships.
Classify Disposable Chafing Dish as a non-food artifact, exclude the catering deposit and alcohol-only menu, and normalize the three size-qualified sauce names.
Deduplicate Palak and Korma across repeated Toast category placements while retaining both complete surface memberships.
Set official allergen status to accurately_unavailable and preserve only direct current restaurant-issued or restaurant-linked ingredient positives.
